thread:
zoe: Quick sync — following yesterday's OOM spike on a Dedicated replica. Root cause suspected: KV tombstone retention + arena fragmentation. Need tight owners for short mitigations.

ian: Can we add a temporary reclaim hook post-compaction? I can implement a toggle flag and unit test. ETA 24h.

mike: I'll take metrics + alerting. Plan: emit runtime.kv.tombstone_count, runtime.kv.post_compact_reclaims, and fragmentation_ratio. Set alert when fragmentation_ratio>0.55 for 10m. ETA 48h.

tara: I'll run a focused canary once Ian's toggle lands. Need staging slot and one Dedicated replica; target Thursday morning. Will validate RSS and allocation histograms.

ops-bot: Created INF-3092: "kv-tombstone-reclaim-action" assigned to ian,mike,tara. Priority: high. Link: https://redwood.internal/inf/INF-3092

zoe: Owners summary for INF-3092: Ian (code + toggle) 24h, Mike (metrics + alerts) 48h, Tara (canary + validation) Thu AM. Also schedule 7-day postmortem check to assess trend.

ian: small note — for Dedicated customers default toggle=off; expose opt-in via support KB.

mike: Uploaded preliminary dashboard panels to https://grafana.redwood/d/runtime/kv-frag, please sanity-check before canary.

tara: Staging slot booked Thu 08:30 PT. I'll post results in INF-3092 and ping here if regressions show.

zoe: Thanks team. Keep updates in the ticket. We'll decide on longer-term refactor after the 7-day telemetry window. :thumbsup:
